title: Convert score fields before accumulating
description: You split file lines into fields and compute an average from numeric scores.

steps.description: You open scores.txt and initialize total and count. Each stripped line becomes a list of comma-separated fields.
You retain the name as text and convert the score with int. str converts that number back to text for the printed sentence.

steps.question: Which update accumulates score values, and which counts processed lines?
steps.answer: total adds score, while count adds one for each processed line.

steps.description: You close the file and divide total by count after the loop. The recorded output ends with the calculated average after the individual score messages.
